title: Detailed flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>

  </defs>
  <!-- Pot body -->
  <path d='M28 55 L32 85 Q32 90 38 90 L62 90 Q68 90 68 85 L72 55 Z' fill='#C96A3A'/>

  <rect x='24' y='47' width='52' height='12' rx='4' fill='#E08A56'/>

  <rect x='26' y='48' width='48' height='4' rx='2' fill='#F0A876'/>

  <path d='M34 60 L36 82 Q36 86 40 86 L44 86 L42 60 Z' fill='#D97B4A' opacity='0.6'/>

  <path d='M49 44 Q42 42 38 46 Q43 48 49 46 Z' fill='#3D8B37'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='24' r='6' fill='#FF5E7E'/>

  <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='5.5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='19' r='5.5' fill='#FF7A96'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='19' r='5.5' fill='#FF7A96'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FF8FAB'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#AEEAFF' opacity='0.8'/>
